title: Public one-boundary matrix-vector products
objective: Implement public dense Matrix times Vector and Vector times Matrix through the integrated storage-neutral one-operation contract, completing generated FLINT-resource ZZ and QQ products with Sage coercion and dimension semantics and explicit capability gates for remaining packed finite-field backends

handoff.summary: Public Matrix*Vector and Vector*Matrix now use a lazy storage-neutral dispatcher. ZZ and QQ cross one generated FLINT-resource boundary, GF(2) borrows M4RI in compiled typed Python, and other packed prime fields use compiler-owned residue buffers. Sage coercion, zero shapes, skew exact values, fresh mutable results, and dimension errors are covered by focused regression tests.
risks: Extension and approximate fields deliberately retain the former temporary row/column matrix fallback until they acquire declared vector ABIs.
The generated FFI wrappers increase the native-integration package ratchet from 605000 to 612000 bytes.
next_steps: Run portable and non-x64 validation after integration.
Measure whether lazy Python orchestration overhead merits a fused public dispatch helper for very small exact products.
